text.에이전트·지침·규칙·skill·hook·권한·MCP 서버를 Claude: Exports agents, instructions, rules, skills, hooks, permissions and MCP servers in the Claude Code project format (.claude/, CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json).
text.팀 구성을 내보낼 때 CLAUDE.md 본문이 될 노드 id. 비우면 없: Id of the node whose content becomes CLAUDE.md when exporting a team. Leave empty for none (it isn't picked automatically).
text.inline: CLAUDE.md에 이어 붙임, separate_files: inline: appended to CLAUDE.md; separate_files: one file per instruction, loaded from CLAUDE.md with @path.
Also exports resources attached to the team layer and the common layer.
text.env_var: secret://이름 → ${이름}, omit: 비밀 칸: env_var: secret://name → ${name}; omit: secret fields aren't written.

codes.export.fields_dropped: Some settings were left out because the format can't express them.
codes.export.invalid_options: The options don't match the format's schema.
codes.export.kind_unsupported: This format doesn't support the definition kind {kind}.
codes.export.main_node_not_found: The main node in the options isn't in the team or isn't an agent node.
codes.export.name_conflict: Skipped because an output with the same name already exists.
codes.export.not_found: Skipped {kind}/{id}: a definition it uses wasn't found.
codes.export.scope_widened: Something attached to one member was written where it applies to the whole project.
codes.export.secret_redacted: Masked values that look like plain-text secrets. Keep secrets as references (secret://).
codes.export.semantics_approximate: The output isn't guaranteed to run exactly like the original definition.
codes.export.type_unsupported: Skipped a resource type the format doesn't handle.
codes.export.unsafe_path: The path is unsafe (escapes the folder, is a link, uses a forbidden name or a protected location).
